headline: Lithium Fund Edges Up While Albemarle Shares Hit Six-Month Low
summary: The LIT lithium fund edged up 0.40% to USD 60.05, while Albemarle shares fell 0.48% to USD 90.56, marking their lowest close in six months.
why: Lithium producers are exposed to cyclical pricing trends in electric vehicle battery materials and supply-demand imbalances in the energy storage sector.

impacts.name: Albemarle Corp
impacts.why: Albemarle shares touched a six-month low amid sector pressures.
